**PNC Financial Services (PNC) 3Q26: Solid Beat vs. 2Q26 on Commercial Loan Growth and Cost Discipline**

**Headline & EPS Drivers:** Focusing on **adjusted** diluted EPS, PNC delivered $5.09 in 3Q26, beating 2Q26 ($4.85) by $0.24 (+5% QoQ) [B0016, B0043]. Reported GAAP EPS rose $0.16 QoQ to $4.97 (+14% YoY) [B0041]. 3Q26 notable items reduced EPS by $(0.12) ($48 million after-tax), comprising $36 million pre-tax in FirstBank integration costs and $(25) million pre-tax in net Visa items (+$11 million share exchange gain, -$36 million Class B-3 derivative adjustments), compared with $(0.04) in 2Q26 [B0068, B0069, B0089]. Stripping out notable items, adjusted EPS growth was powered by strong NII (+$99 million QoQ), a 3% ($113 million) drop in adjusted noninterest expense, lower preferred dividends ($73 million vs. $85 million), and a lower effective tax rate (20.0% vs. 20.5%) [B0029, B0036, B0102, B0404].

**Revenue & Margin:** GAAP NII grew $99 million (+2% QoQ) to $4,206 million on a $9.0 billion (+2% QoQ) jump in average loans to $372.2 billion (commercial loans +$10.4 billion, +4% QoQ) and 3% securities growth [B0029, B0105, B0112]. FTE NIM eased 2 bps QoQ to 2.94% as higher interest-bearing liability costs (+10 bps to 2.49%) slightly outpaced earning-asset yield expansion (+8 bps to 4.90%) [B0058, B0873, B0887]. Average deposits rose 1% to $461.2 billion and spot deposits jumped 4% ($16.6 billion) to $466.4 billion [B0050, B0114, B0437]. Reported noninterest income fell $412 million (-15% QoQ) to $2,356 million (adjusted -$160 million to $2,390 million) as capital markets normalized (-$144 million from elevated 2Q26) and 2Q26 included a $218 million net notable benefit [B0032, B0158, B0534]. Reported expenses dropped 8% QoQ to $3,751 million (adjusted -3% to $3,724 million on lower compensation), improving the reported efficiency ratio 300 bps to 57% [B0034, B0036, B0060, B0175].

**Credit:** Provision was steady at $189 million (-$2 million QoQ) [B0038]. NCOs rose $31 million to $257 million (0.28% vs. 0.25%), but included $35 million from transferring a $1.4 billion student loan portfolio to HFS [B0026, B0256, B0260]. Delinquencies fell 9% to $1,301 million, though commercial NPLs drove total NPLs up 8% to $2,194 million (0.58%); ACL/loans fell 6 bps to 1.42% [B0258, B0259, B0261, B0262].

**Capital & Returns:** ROTCE expanded 40 bps QoQ to 18.28% [B0056]. CET1 edged down 10 bps to 9.8% following $0.6 billion in buybacks and $0.8 billion in common dividends (quarterly dividend raised to $2.00) [B0061, B0116, B0117, B0131]. TBVPS fell 3% to $107.64 as AOCI widened to $(6.5) billion [B0046, B0051].

**Guidance & Thesis:** PNC expects 4Q26 buybacks to match 3Q26 (~$0.6 billion), with its SCB locked at 2.5% through 2027 [B0118, B0246]. Strong commercial momentum and 18%+ ROTCE reinforce the core thesis.
